sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Find the volume of a square pyramid with base edge 2 and height 5. Leave π in the answer where it appears.
Describe the cross-section formed by a cylinder cut by a plane perpendicular to its base through the axis.
A solid object has mass 84 g and volume 12 cm³. Find its density, and state whether it would float in water (density 1 g/cm³).
A square patio of side 7 m is to be paved at $9 per square metre. Find the total cost, and state which quantity the cost is proportional to.
choices: $63; the cost is proportional to the area
$252; the cost is proportional to the perimeter
$441; the cost is proportional to the area
$441; the cost is proportional to the side length

items.prompt: Find the volume of a cone of radius 12 and height 11. Leave π in the answer where it appears.
Describe the cross-section formed by a cylinder cut by a plane parallel to its base.
A solid object has mass 165 g and volume 11 cm³. Find its density, and state whether it would float in water (density 1 g/cm³).
A square patio of side 20 m is to be paved at $8 per square metre. Find the total cost, and state which quantity the cost is proportional to.
choices: $640; the cost is proportional to the perimeter
$3200; the cost is proportional to the side length
$160; the cost is proportional to the area
$3200; the cost is proportional to the area
